user.title: Add a NovaStar controller
user.description: Enter the IP address of the controller (for example a VX1000). Home Assistant connects to its control port and scans every output for receiving cards. The cards it finds become the expected layout, so any card that later stops answering is reported as a problem. Nothing is ever written to the controller.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. The port is 5200 unless you changed it.
